setup.title: Set up in seconds
setup.body: No lengthy profile, no swiping. Make an account and you are talking to someone new almost immediately.

nothingSaved.title: Nothing saved
nothingSaved.body: When a random chat ends, it is gone for good — nothing from it is stored or resurfaced later.

live.title: See who is live
live.body: Real presence, not stale counters. Every room shows exactly who is connected as it changes.

free.title: Free, no catch
free.body: Matching, rooms and private messaging are all completely free. No card, no trial, no paywall.

matching.a:
Hit "Find a match" and we pair you one-on-one with someone else looking to chat right now, prioritizing people who share your interests.
You can end the chat and find a new match anytime! Nothing from a random chat is saved once it ends.

free.a: Yes! Creating an account, matching with strangers, joining rooms and messaging friends are all completely free features.

notifications.q: Can I control which notifications I get?
notifications.a: Yes. In 'Settings' > 'Preferences' you can turn popups and sounds on or off individually for friend requests, accepted requests, direct messages, room messages, and post likes. Plus set a master volume.

reports.q: What happens if someone reports me or I report someone?
reports.a:
Reports go to our moderation team for review. Accounts that violate our guidelines can be suspended for a set period or permanently.
If this happens to your account, you'll see the reason and duration.
If someone's made you uncomfortable, please use the report option!

delete.q: Can I delete my account and data?
delete.a: Yes, anytime! From 'Settings' > 'Account'. Deleting your account permanently removes your profile, posts, messages and friend connections - beware this can't be undone!
